authored_assumptions: All dimensions, room divisions, furniture placement, fixtures and floor uses are authored inside the retained source-sized partial floor plates.
This is not a surveyed reconstruction of all rooms or of the real City Hall atrium. Existing slabs, stairs, lifts, exits and outdoor collision remain the authoritative safety structure.
Hotel/gallery/public/office profiles selected from existing building titles and known IDs are game interpretations, not verified tenant directories or real access rights.
Unidentified buildings retain an office interpretation with deterministic game variations.
Procedural metre-scale tile, wood, plaster and fabric finishes are original shader code; they are not scanned materials or downloaded photos.
Before comparison pictures remain the existing EXP04 records, whose source version differs from EXP07.
Books, return terminals, queue machines, coffee equipment, tenant signs and room furnishings are visual game props; they do not provide lending, check-in, banking or other real services.
Glass partitions, lobby cores and open guest-room bays are authored internal divisions, not new independent measured footprint data.
Protected central, front cross-corridor and western stair approach zones remain clear; all newly added solid furniture must pass the same footprint guards.

profile_interpretation.library: Existing library kind/ID; wooden library furniture and stepped reading corner inspired by official photographs.
profile_interpretation.civic: City Hall ID or title containing 시청; a public guidance/service/lounge game programme.
profile_interpretation.hotel: Titles containing 호텔, hotel, Westin or 프레이저; authored lobby, lounge and guest rooms.
profile_interpretation.gallery: Titles containing 미술관, 박물관, 아트센터 or 전시; authored foyer, exhibit panels and display cases.
profile_interpretation.chapel: Titles identifying a church; authored benches, lectern and community room.
profile_interpretation.residential: Titles identifying apartments; authored shared entrance, mail/parcel area and numbered apartment doors.
profile_interpretation.bank: Titles identifying a bank; authored customer counters, seating and consultation rooms.
profile_interpretation.office: Fallback for other/unknown buildings; ID-selected floor programme variations, not verified tenants.
